caveats.id: Vektor satelit pada lapisan relevan tidak saling sepakat (R<0.7); arah lapisan tersebut tidak pasti.
caveats.en: Satellite vectors in a relevant layer disagree (R<0.7); that layer's direction is uncertain.
caveats.plain_id: Untuk lapisan ini pengukuran satelit saling bertentangan—arahnya belum pasti.
caveats.plain_en: For this layer the satellite measurements disagree—its direction is not yet certain.

caveats.id: Sumber-sumber berbeda arah 45-90° (divergen): bukan koroborasi, bukan pula konflik tegas.
caveats.en: Sources diverge by 45-90 degrees: neither corroborated nor squarely conflicting.
caveats.plain_id: Sumber resmi dan perhitungan satelit tidak sepenuhnya sepakat hari ini.
caveats.plain_en: Official and satellite sources do not fully agree today.

caveats.id: Kecepatan endapan dikoreksi kepadatan udara v(h)=v0·√(ρ0/ρ(h)); sebaran memakai σ²=σ0²+2Kt+(geser·t)² yang mengikuti massa airborne Φ(t): ambang deteksi ikut menipis saat awan menyebar, sehingga lebar bisa naik lalu turun.
caveats.en: Settling velocity density-corrected v(h)=v0·√(ρ0/ρ(h)); spread uses σ²=σ0²+2Kt+(shear·t)² coupled to the airborne mass Φ(t): the detection threshold dilutes as the cloud spreads, so the width can rise and then fall.
caveats.plain_id: Perhitungan memakai abu yang jatuh perlahan, menyebar, dan angin yang berubah theo ketinggian—dengan ketidakpastian yang jujur.
caveats.plain_en: The calculation accounts for ash settling slowly, spreading, and wind changing with height—with honest uncertainty.

caveats.id: ECMWF/GFS/ICON beresolusi ~9-25 km: sirkulasi lokal mesoscale (angin laut/darat, topografi) tidak tertangkap.
caveats.en: ECMWF/GFS/ICON run at ~9-25 km grids: local mesoscale circulations (sea/land breeze, terrain flows) are not resolved.
caveats.plain_id: Angin lokal (pantai, lembah, gunung) terlalu kecil untuk terlihat model cuaca global.
caveats.plain_en: Local winds (coastal, valley, mountain) are too small for global weather models to see.

caveats.id: Model cuaca (ECMWF/GFS/ICON) saling berbeda hingga 73° pada sebagian lapisan.
caveats.en: NWP models (ECMWF/GFS/ICON) disagree by up to 73 degrees on some layers.
caveats.plain_id: Model cuaca saling berbeda cukup jauh di sebagian ketinggian.
caveats.plain_en: The weather models differ noticeably at some heights.

caveats.id: Tanpa kunci FIRMS: tidak ada uji-silak hotspot independen untuk 'erupsi berlangsung'.
caveats.en: No FIRMS key set: no independent hotspot cross-check for 'eruption ongoing'.
caveats.plain_id: Belum ada pemeriksaan silang hotspot NASA hari ini.

caveats.id: Lintasan memakai angin prakiraan per jam + pengendapan 3 kelas abu + difusi; varian angin-tetap ikut disertakan.
caveats.en: Trajectories use hourly-evolving forecast wind + 3 settling classes + diffusion; a steady-wind variant ships alongside.
caveats.plain_id: Garis pergerakan adalah prakiraan, bukan jaminan.
caveats.plain_en: The tracks are a forecast, not a promise.
